description:
Add, rename, delete and browse People on any Jellyfin item, including Photos and Videos that don't natively support People. Includes a gallery view and orphan cleanup tools.
Compatible with Jellyfin 10.11.x only. NOT tested or supported on Jellyfin 12.0+, which introduced a new database schema — this plugin writes directly to internal tables and may break on newer versions.
name: People Toolkit
overview: Manage People on any item, including Photos (Jellyfin 10.11.x only)
